name: Helped - Private Media Transcription (Make AI Content Extractor)

notes: Module 6 is Make AI Content Extractor > Transcribe an audio file (make-ai-extractors:transcribeAnAudio). It receives the short-lived signed mediaUrl from webhook module 1. The extractor accepts WebM recordings.
The Webhook Response returns module 6's text as transcript and keeps syncJobId from webhook module 1. Test with Run once before turning the scenario on.
The Worker sends a private Supabase Storage URL signed for 15 minutes and expects { transcript: string }. Do not expose storageRef or replace the signed URL with a permanent public URL.
Make AI Content Extractor is available on paid plans and currently consumes 20 Make credits per audio minute; pricing may change while the feature is in beta.

metadata.notes: Returns the Make AI Content Extractor text output as transcript. The Worker expects JSON { ok: true, syncJobId, transcript: string }. Run once in Make to validate the module output mapping before setting MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL_MEDIA_TRANSCRIBE.
